# Lehigh Valley Live

> Local marketplace platform for vehicles and real estate in the Lehigh Valley region.

Lehigh Valley Live operates classified marketplaces for automotive and real estate categories, serving the Lehigh Valley, Easton, and Bethlehem communities. The platform connects buyers and sellers through dedicated vertical marketplaces for vehicles and properties.

## Key Topics

- new cars
- certified pre-owned

## Automotive Marketplace

- [Buy New & Used Cars | Lehigh Valley Autos](https://autos.lehighvalleylive.com/): Vehicle marketplace for buying new, used, and certified pre-owned cars in Lehigh Valley.

## Real Estate & Housing

- [Real Estate Classifieds | LehighValleyLive.com](https://realestate.lehighvalleylive.com/): Real estate classifieds and property listings for Lehigh Valley, Easton, and Bethlehem.
